collection.description: A craftsperson offers a new plant fiber for closing deep wounds, but the material may irritate the body.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A craftsperson offers a new plant fiber for closing deep wounds, but the material may irritate the body.

choices.label: Try it on a consenting patient.
Test the fiber for durability and cleanliness.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The wound closes neatly, but swelling develops around the thread.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The patient heals, and the healer cautiously records a promising result.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The wound reopens, and the patient requires further care.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The fiber weakens when wet and is rejected for surgery.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The healer finds a safer use for the fiber in external bandages.

b1__fx.name: Outcome B1
b1__fx.text: The wound heals slowly without the new material.

b1__text.text: The wound heals slowly without the new material.
